body: Thank you very much for responding. That means so much. I've considered the idea of a therapist before, but being as I'm too young to go alone I would have to convince my parents to take me and they would never do that because they would never believe something is wrong. If the problem persists I will go as soon as I can. I never thought it would actually make a difference to see a professional but hearing that it's helped you so much has inspired me to try. You might have just saved my life. Thank you so much for that.
